description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Resource_File, an internal plugin for Smarty templating engine. It implements methods to handle Smarty template resources stored in the filesystem, including methods for populating template source metadata, loading template content, and resolving template file paths.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_File
classes.description: A class implementing the Smarty template resource handling via filesystem, providing methods for resource path resolution, content loading, and metadata population.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata such as filepath, timestamp, and existence status based on the resource.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp and existence status of the source object based on the filesystem.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the source template content from the filesystem, throws exception if unable.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns the basename of the resource filepath.

methods.name: buildFilepath
methods.description: Resolves the full filepath of a template resource, considering relative paths, directories, and include paths.
